item.title: Adding Codepen Pens to Hugo Posts
item.description:
Codepen on Hugo!⤴️

When I was building my Genuary post, I was poked around for a solution to embedding some Codepen pens on the post. For some reason I had no luck on my first search, but found a solution from this guy Alex on a follow-up search. All credit to Alex for the shortcode, but figured I’d share an overview of the solution here, largely because I wanted to learn codeblocks.

item.title: Genuary 2023
item.description:
After some indirect encouragement from some folks on my Mastodon instance, I’ve decided to try my hand at Genuary! Each day of the month has a theme, and they were a lot of fun to contemplate and attempt.

Compared to many, my love affair with code is rather young, so don’t expect to be blown away by any of these outputs below, which are actually rather simple edits of existing pens I found. But rest assured knowing I had lots of fun creating these edits! This post on my previous site had a nice handy widget where I listed all all 30 days, but I couldn’t get that done here, so here are some Codepen embeds instead.
